title: Psychiatry Weekly: Psilocybin NDA and Methadone After Overdose
description: Compass Pathways completes its NDA for COMP360 in treatment-resistant depression, a Canadian cohort compares methadone and buprenorphine after overdose, and overdose deaths keep falling. Plus a quiet week in consultation-liaison and neuropsychiatry, and a round-up.
